segments.text: Okay let's get started with the weekly sync.
So this week we finished the login page redesign, it's ready for review.
Great, I'll take a look today and give feedback by tomorrow.
Also we need to decide on the deployment date, are we still targeting Friday?
Let's push it to Monday instead, I want more testing time before the weekend.
One open question - do we know if the client has approved the new pricing yet?
Not yet, I'll follow up with them and update everyone.
Perfect, thanks everyone, that's all for today.
